name: Twitch Drops for 2027 Pokémon Latin America International Championships
title: Twitch Drops for 2027 Pokémon Latin America International Championships
description: Get codes for exclusive Timed Research and a Battle Bundle during the 2027 Pokémon Latin America International Championships Twitch broadcast. PsyRhino took home the gold at the 2026 Pokémon GO North America International Championships with a powerful Shadow Samurott on their team. Watch the 2027 LAIC stream, and you can get a Samurott inspired by PsyRhino’s NAIC-winning team. Tune in to Twitch.tv/PokemonGO on November 20 and 21, or Twitch.tv/Pokemon on November 22, and you’ll earn rewards the longer you watch. Here’s what you can get: Watch for 30 minutes: Unique Timed Research that includes the following. Watch for 45 minutes: An LAIC Battle Bundle that includes the following. Timed Research tasks must be completed and rewards claimed before Friday, December 4, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. PST. Find more information on the Timed Research from the Twitch Drops in the Research section .

name: Twilight Trails
title: Twilight Trails
description: Welcome to Pokémon GO: Twilight Trails! In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.
